import FormalConjecturesUtil

namespace WilsonPrime

/-- A Wilson prime is a prime $p$ such that $p^2 \mid (p-1)!+1$. -/
def IsWilsonPrime (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ (p - 1).factorial + 1

/-- The prime $7$ is not a Wilson prime. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem not_isWilsonPrime_seven : ¬ IsWilsonPrime 7 := by
  intro h
  have h2 : 7 ^ 2 ∣ (7 - 1).factorial + 1 := h.2
  have h3 : (7 - 1).factorial + 1 = 721 := by decide
  rw [h3] at h2
  omega

end WilsonPrime

import FormalConjecturesUtil

namespace ClaudesCycles

abbrev Vertex (m : ℕ) := Fin 3 → ZMod m

def bumpAt {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (b : Fin 3) (v : Vertex m) : Vertex m :=
  Function.update v b (v b + 1)

def cubeAdj {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (u v : Vertex m) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Fin 3, bumpAt b u = v

def IsDirectedHamiltonianCycle {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (adj : V → V → Prop) (σ : Equiv.Perm V) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, adj v (σ v)) ∧ σ.IsCycle ∧ σ.support = Finset.univ

def HasHamiltonianArcDecomposition (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Vertex m),
    (∀ c, IsDirectedHamiltonianCycle (cubeAdj (m := m)) (σ c)) ∧
    (∀ v : Vertex m, ∀ b : Fin 3, ∃! c : Fin 3, σ c v = bumpAt b v)

@[category test, AMS 5]
theorem not_hasHamiltonianArcDecomposition_one : ¬ HasHamiltonianArcDecomposition 1 := by
  rintro ⟨σ, hσ, -⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hc, -⟩ := hσ 0
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hc
  exact hx (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

end ClaudesCycles

import FormalConjecturesUtil

open SimpleGraph

namespace VizingConjecture

theorem vizing_conjecture.variants.dominationNumber_eq_one
    {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) (hH : H.dominationNumber = 1) :
    G.dominationNumber * H.dominationNumber ≤ (G □ H).dominationNumber := by
  have hne : Nonempty β := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    have : H.dominationNumber = 0 := by
      apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
      apply Nat.sInf_le
      refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
      constructor
      · intro v; exact (IsEmpty.false v).elim
      · simp
    omega
  rw [hH, mul_one]
  exact dominationNumber_le_dominationNumber_boxProd G H

end VizingConjecture
